Lens guide

Make them yours.

Pick a frame first, then choose the lens type that matches your prescription.

Find a frame ↗
Single vision

One prescription across the lens, usually for either distance or reading.

Progressive

Multiple viewing distances in one lens, with a gradual transition between them. Fitting measurements may be needed before the lenses can be made.

How do I enter my prescription?

Choose “Enter prescription manually” in the builder to try the right and left eye fields. Use fictional values for this preview. You can also use a sample prescription or choose to provide it later.
